title: Hunts FH-046S: Mount the donation ask on the Space donation checkout and sync gifts

source.ref: Split from FH-036..040 (2026-11-10): the pure core, storage and tests shipped dark behind HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED; the live call sites move here.

detail:
Behind D8 approval (FH-045), mount HuntDonationAsk through decideDonationAsk, reuse the Space donation checkout and receipt, mirror each donation into hunt_donation_gifts with giftStatusFromDonation on success, abandonment and refund, and show settledDonationTotals. Done when: success, abandonment and full and partial refunds show the right settled totals and no player's progress changes. Requires: FH-046, FH-045. Owner role: Billing and CRM.

Built 2026-11-16: lib/hunts/donation-sync.ts. The ask opens through decideDonationAsk only (HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED on, an enabled ask with a recorded approver, a live or ended Trail, a beneficiary Space with a published fund that can receive money); components/hunts/hunt-fundraising.tsx mounts it on the play page with the Space donation form, so the charge, card panel and receipt are the Space fund's own. The start action re-checks the gate server-side and refuses a Trail gift when it is closed. The Stripe webhook mirrors each tagged donation into hunt_donation_gifts through giftStatusFromDonation on settle, late payment, expiry and refund; a refunded amount only grows. Totals price each gift from the canonical donation as it stands. Tests cover success, abandonment, full and partial refund, the missing approval, the switch off, and that no run, claim or progress row is read or written. Not done here and not claimed: the D8 sign-off (FH-045) and a live provider acceptance run, which moved to FH-046T.
